data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 海滨凉亭里的夏日湿身交缠
data.description: 私密海滨遮阳凉亭内海浪声声，亮黄比基尼细带早已解开。浑身泛着晶莹海水的健康身躯紧密相贴，短发微湿，柠檬在急促的娇喘与浪潮声中紧抓你的双肩，眼神里全都是沦陷的爱恋。
data.location: private secluded beach cabana with wooden floorboards overlooking ocean
data.action: straddling partner on cabana lounger with untied yellow bikini, wet tanned skin glistening with sea droplets, clinging tightly in heated embrace
data.lighting: dappled sea sunlight filtering through wooden slats onto glistening skin
data.mood: steamy sun-kissed passion, vibrant tropical intimacy, breathless romantic bliss
data.promptProse: In a beach cabana with an untied yellow bikini, tanned Lemon Yakishio straddles partner with wet glistening skin and heavy breathless blushes.
data.animaCaption: Lemon Yakishio with untied bikini embracing passionately in beach cabana.
